verdicts.conflict: Export controls versus physical audit trails in constraining frontier AI capability growth
verdicts.rationale: The safetyist position relies on concrete physical constraints like multi-thousand chip clusters and dedicated power grids. The accelerationist claim regarding algorithmic efficiency lacks comparable hard infrastructure metrics for near-term frontier runs.

verdicts.conflict: Decentralized cluster evasion versus centralized utility monitoring
verdicts.rationale: The safetyist argument specifies measurable physical requirements for frontier training. The counter-argument relies on hypothetical decentralized scaling without citing specific network capacities or latency limits.
